title: Publish dev: merge knowledge-track v0.1/v0.2 into main and push
body: origin has only `main` at the scaffold commit (c8d9c69). `dev` carries the two knowledge-track commits (36b9bb2, 410635f) and has never been pushed. The `refs/foam/data` ref is not on origin either, so `foam sync` is needed for other clones to see issues.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/5e2bceba
notes.text: Dylan (2026-10-26): hold the merge/push until knowledge-track has real logic built in, i.e. the policy layer (research-tools-55c5ed), not just storage + CLI.
